Name: Auto Bet on Green
Author: makaboo
Description:
[b]General Description[/b]
Allows the players to automatically bet on green on the Stardew Valley Fair festival with a predefined amount of tokens, skipping a few dialogues, like choosing between Orange and Green, typing the amount of star tokens to bet, which is time consuming when players want to bet multiple times. The idea is to improve the player experience to bet multiple times on green faster. 

The current implementation automatically bets 46.7% of the start tokens in the player bag, which is the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Stardew_Valley_Fair#cite_ref-OptimalBet_2-0]optimal value[/url] for most cases disconsidering the player luck.
[b]
[/b]
